bagPolicy.summary: The Shrine Auditorium does not allow oversized purses or backpacks: anything over 14 x 14 x 6 inches, including luggage and duffle bags.
allowed: Purses and backpacks up to 14 x 14 x 6 inches
prohibited: Purses, backpacks, luggage and duffle bags over 14 x 14 x 6 inches
Plastic and metal water bottles, glass bottles, cans, cups and coolers
Outside food and drinks, including candy and gum
Professional cameras with detachable lenses, GoPros, tripods and selfie sticks
Eye drops, and open packs of cigarettes
Glow sticks, flashlights, laser pointers and LED lights
Chain wallets and spiked collars or belts
bagPolicy.note: No water bottle of any kind is allowed, empty or full. The list is long and strict compared with most theaters, so travel light.

parking.summary: Park in the Shrine-operated North Parking Structure at 714 W. 32nd Street. Buy advance parking to guarantee a spot; if you see Lot Full signs, check in with the attendant. The USC Shrine Structure and Royal St Structure are run by USC, so follow their Text to Park signs. ADA parking is in the North Parking Structure, West Lot, and USC Shrine Structure.

rideshare.summary: Set your rideshare pickup and drop-off address to 665 West Jefferson Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90007.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages, including candy, alcohol and water bottles, are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue’s prohibited-items page permits service animals but does not detail accessible seating or entry.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed. Once you are inside the venue, there are no ins and outs.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets can be picked up at the box-office window starting two hours before the show; bring the purchasing card and valid photo ID. The venue will not accept third-party will-call drop-offs.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Mobile AXS tickets are scanned at entry; the ticket page does not provide a fixed door-opening time for every concert.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
